rules.name: One accent, one meaning
rules.body: Yellow is work and action, cyan is flagship AI, red is energy, and green is nominal state.

rules.name: Evidence before decoration
rules.body: The event display, project routes, subsystem rows, and data panels carry the experience.

rules.name: Isolation is an affordance
rules.body: Selecting a track dims the field and exposes the project's data without hiding the route.

dos: Keep SVG geometry decorative and expose interaction through real anchors.
Keep focus, touch, RTL, and reduced-motion behavior equivalent.
donts: Don't use generic gradients or decorative glass.
Don't turn the journey into identical icon cards or hide route names from touch and keyboard users.
